evidence_scope: Host descriptor layout, encoding and rejection fixtures only. No native runtime, hardware, model execution, transport interoperability or CUDA support is qualified.

requirements: Model and tokenizer identities are lowercase SHA-256 hex strings; they are identity fields, not artifact signature or file-content verification.
The shard list contains 1-1024 records ordered by index and covering 0 through count-1; half-open layer ranges are contiguous and cover the declared positive u32 layer_count exactly.
State precision equals model precision. All state records share a nonzero u64 placement epoch and have positive u32 ownership generations distinct from capability-handle generations.
Memory fields are nonnegative u64 byte counts; total is the overflow-checked exact sum of weights, state, workspace, transfer and reserved_growth.
Unknown fields, duplicate JSON keys, unknown operators, architecture, precision, layout, quantization and implicit conversions are rejected.

non_goals: implicit adoption of later UDP framing

cuda_profile.name: proposed-source-compiled-driver-subset-v1
cuda_profile.reference_policy: Archived API reference pin; this does not select or qualify a deployed driver, nvcc binary, device ISA, firmware or source/export-symbol ABI.
restrictions: Source spellings identify planned behavior only. Exact declarations, header macro mappings, export suffixes and allowed flags require the later source-compiled native facade and its conformance tests.
ModuleLoadData is intended for one validated exact-target device-only cubin; PTX, fatbins, JIT and runtime linking are rejected.
Allocation and asynchronous host transfers require native region ownership, registration, accounting and lifetime fences; caller pointers never cross the descriptor boundary.
The first profile uses explicitly created non-default streams; legacy/default-stream and cross-thread scheduling compatibility is unqualified.
Unknown flags, attributes, parameter layouts, module targets and unsupported operations fail explicitly before work. No permissive success stub is allowed.
unsupported_families: CUDA Runtime API and fatbin registration
cuda_profile.unsupported_behavior: A later native facade must return an explicit unsupported or invalid-input error without a side effect. The host fixture does not implement CUDA calls or error-code translation.
qualification_pending: source facade signatures and symbol versions

toolchain_profile.language_layout_policy: C11 host probes execute byte roundtrips; pinned no_std Rust freestanding probes compile layout and constant byte assertions without host/native service execution. Descriptors use explicit-width little-endian scalars.
toolchain_profile.whole_G02_gate: open; remaining G01 dependency and native runtime evidence required

compatibility_matrix.capability: ABI 1.0 host byte layout and rejection
alternate CUDA, AMD or Apple backends
